why: Fix round for slice S2 of docs/plan/quests/port-scripts-0113-PLAN.md (ticket 766, our tooling), after the review sent it back with two faults, on branch fabrikalfa/port-0113-s02 from 1dae5d1. origin/main merged in first, with no conflict. Fault 1: .agents/skills/lead/scripts/git/GitTest.ts now computes git's best common ancestors (common ancestors that are no ancestor of another common ancestor) and refuses with GitError unless there is exactly one, and its file diff answers only when the lines shared outside the trimmed start and end are none, so every smallest diff changes the same lines; a moved or swapped line, an empty file and a file without its last newline are refused with GitError. The integration law in .agents/skills/lead/scripts/git/git.integration.test.ts now builds each history step by step: after the first base, work and main commits, a walk reads each raw step against the history built so far and makes a commit on work, main or a side branch (append, insert, remove, replace, move, swap, drop the last newline, add or delete a file), a side branch, or a --no-ff merge of main into work, work into main, the side into work, or the commit before work's tip into main (a criss-cross); a merge is offered only when git would make a merge commit, so a merge of an ancestor is one. After every step both layers answer alike or the model refuses with GitError, and where real git names more than one merge base the model must refuse. Coverage is asserted once per property: an answer after a merge of an ancestor and after a merge of main into work, a moved-line edit, a history with several merge bases, an answer and a refusal. The review's two counterexamples are pinned in fast-check's examples with the bug named. Fault 2: a new law runs node governance.ts as a real process on the walked repository and asserts exit 0 with stdout equal to the in-process lines, exit 1 for an unknown base, and exit 2 for a bad command line. Merge task: GitProcess.ts and GitTest.ts make GitError with GitError.make (newSchemaClass); GitProcess.ts was committed on its own as the build step, as the coordinator assigned. The unstableApiUsage error the brief named for runsFor did not appear on the merged tree: main's next/packages/vitest/src/Depth.ts no longer carries a stability tag, so the test keeps runsFor unchanged, as the other tests on main do. Red first: against the old model the law failed on the pinned ancestor merge (the model's diff showed notes/main-only.md and Y's file as added where git's diff was empty), on the pinned swap (the model changed 4 lines where git changed 2), and on generated walks alone with no examples (a swap in a decision file).
